name: Aayla Secura's lightsaber
description: Aayla Secura's lightsaber was the personal lightsaber of the Twi'lek Jedi Master Aayla Secura by the time of the Clone Wars. The lightsaber produced a blue-blade when ignited and had a durasteel hilt. The hilt itself was designed for durability during long missions and so that its inner workings were easily accessible if Secura needed to repair it in the field. The hilt's upper portion sported a ridged grip section and controls for adjusting the blade's length and intensity.
